serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Now that I think about it…
During these riots I never went to check on Annalie…
I hope she’s alright.
Some of the places like shops and bars I went by were in pretty bad shape…
Oh no…
Now that I see her shop from the outside, I see that she got the short end of the stick…
Windows are broken and in their place is black foil heavily taped from the inside…
